source.author: cic
source.text: negas me audere quod sentiam dicere: quasi tibi, cum impudenter me rogares, parum fortiter responderim.
source.text_original: negas me audere quod sentiam dicere: quasi tibi, cum impudenter me rogares, parum fortiter responderim.
source.text_english: You say that I do not dare to say what I think, as if I had not answered you firmly enough when you shamelessly asked me.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Primae in libris , quos nuper Pammachio nostro iubente interpretatus sum, Origenes fortissime respondit; quo detentus opere inplere non potui, quod tibi promiseram, et Danielem nostrum rursum comperendinaui.
reuse.text_original: Primae in libris περὶ ἀρχῶν, quos nuper Pammachio nostro iubente interpretatus sum, Origenes fortissime respondit; quo detentus opere inplere non potui, quod tibi promiseram, et Danielem nostrum rursum comperendinaui.
reuse.text_english: In the first books, which I recently translated at our Pammachius’s command, Origen answered most vigorously; detained by that work, I was unable to carry out what I had promised you, and I have again put off our Daniel until the day after tomorrow.
